subject.title: fix(ios): block incomplete shares when attachments are omitted

question: Should incomplete iOS shares be rejected entirely whenever any selected attachment would be omitted, rather than warning while allowing the supported subset to send?
rationale: Both behaviors can be implemented correctly, but the PR deliberately replaces an existing partial-send workflow with fail-closed product semantics that affect mixed text and attachment shares.

options.title: Block incomplete shares
options.body: Accept the PR’s fail-closed behavior so the agent never receives a silently incomplete representation of the user’s selection.

options.title: Warn and allow partial send
options.body: Preserve partial sending behind an explicit confirmation, accepting that the agent will receive only the supported subset.

options.title: Expand attachment transport first
options.body: Pause this PR and add video/file transport, which avoids omission but substantially broadens the gateway and iOS implementation scope.

recommendation.title: Block incomplete shares
recommendation.body: Accept the PR’s fail-closed behavior so the agent never receives a silently incomplete representation of the user’s selection.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and active replacement work connect steipete most directly to the Share Extension’s current behavior and product boundary.
